# ARC 25-shot s123 Cross-Benchmark Results (2026-05-21)

## 完整 ARC accuracy 表

| Family | d000 | d005 | d025 | d050 | d100 | Δ(d100) |
|--------|------|------|------|------|------|---------|
| Qwen-14B | 90.44% | 91.47% | 89.76% | 88.74% | 87.29% | **-3.15pp** |

| OLMo-2 | 76.88% | 77.22% | 76.62% | 79.18% | 79.78% | **+2.90pp** |

## MMLU vs ARC Cross-Benchmark Direction Comparison (seed=123)

| Family | MMLU Δ(s123) | ARC Δ(s123) | Direction Match |
|--------|-------------|-------------|-----------------|
| Qwen-14B | -12.74pp | -3.15pp | ✅ Both negative (Collapse) |

- **Qwen-14B**: Collapse 在两个 benchmark 一致，ARC 幅度较小（-3.15 vs -12.74），可能因 ARC 天花板效应
- **Phi-4**: Immune 模式跨 benchmark 稳定，MMLU 和 ARC 均为正向微弱变化
